title: SEC↔ALL-SIRC-001: Security Implementation Readiness Checklist
description: Per-role security champion attests, before a Security Engineer review, that all CONFIRMED security controls are implemented and verified (shift-left gate, §3.2). JSON Schema translation of the authoritative SECURITY_IMPLEMENTATION_READINESS_SCHEMA (v1.0.0); validation rules V-SIRC-01..15 apply. SEC review feeds HG-01 (Security release veto).

submitting_role.description: Obsidian wikilink to role SKILL file.

attestation.const: I attest that all CONFIRMED items have been implemented and verified

control_reference.description: Standard citation (IEC 62443 / NIST / OWASP) — required for mandatory items (V-SIRC-14).

architect_signoff.description: Required when any checklist item has risk_accepted = true (V-SIRC-11).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Security-baseline surface — ESC-SEC; feeds HG-01 (Security release veto, permanent HITL gate). Agents may only propose; SEC owns binding decisions.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (before Planning→Development, §3.2 shift-left gate; before SEC review scheduling)
confirm_conditions: id matches the SIRC regex and summary counts reconcile (V-SIRC-12)
gate_result = READY implies failed_count = 0 and every mandatory item status = CONFIRMED
every CONFIRMED item has non-null evidence; every mandatory item cites an IEC 62443/NIST/OWASP control
if any risk_accepted = true, architect_signoff.signed = true
reject_conditions: any mandatory item status = FAILED (blocks SEC review scheduling; SEC cannot approve — V-SIRC-15)
a mandatory item UNCERTAIN with risk_accepted = false
counter_conditions: status = UNCERTAIN with a reason but no risk decision — request risk acceptance or remediation plan
control_reference cites a non-standard source — request a recognized standard citation
